adjudication.rationale: The diff shows refreshOAuthTokens.ts at lines 6-14 making a fetch call to process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT without any timeout/abort controller. This is a real defect - if the sync endpoint is slow or unresponsive, the fetch will hang indefinitely. The code path is used by multiple calendar services (Google, Office365, Zoom, etc.) as shown in the diff, so a stalled endpoint could block calendar operations. This is a verifiable bug in the newly added code.
